title: Near-Far Attention: Region-Aware Sparse Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context decoding, but token selection introduces additional scoring and ranking overhead. Moreover, uniform page scoring overlooks differences in relevance between near and far context. We propose Near-Far Attention (NFA), which adapts retrieval to regional attention patterns while keeping candidate scoring lightweight. During prefill, the Lightweight Gate Estimator identifies regions that can be skipped during decoding, adding less than 1% to dense-prefill time. For the remaining regions, the Calibration-Free Subspace Extractor supplies compact features shared by page-level and token-level scoring without offline calibration. The Distance-Aware Two-Level Selector then scores near and far pages differently and jointly ranks candidate tokens under a shared budget. Evaluations across model families, parameter scales, and GQA/MLA architectures show aggregate task quality comparable to full attention

translated_title: 远近注意力：面向长上下文LLM解码的区域感知稀疏检索
translated_abstract: 稀疏注意力降低了长上下文解码的成本，但token选择引入了额外的评分和排序开销。此外，统一的页面评分方式忽略了近处上下文与远处上下文之间相关性的差异。我们提出了远近注意力（Near-Far Attention, NFA），它在保持候选评分轻量化的同时，使检索机制能够适应不同区域的注意力模式。在预填充（prefill）阶段，轻量级门控估计器识别出解码时可以跳过的区域，仅为密集预填充时间增加不到1%的开销。对于其余区域，免校准子空间提取器提供紧凑特征，供页面级和token级评分共享使用，且无需离线校准。随后，距离感知的两级选择器对近处和远处页面采用不同的评分方式，并在共享预算下对候选token进行联合排序。跨模型家族、参数规模以及GQA/MLA架构的评估表明，该方法在综合任务质量上与完整注意力相当。
tldr: 提出远近注意力（NFA）方法，通过轻量级门控估计器、免校准子空间提取器和距离感知两级选择器实现区域感知的稀疏检索，在长上下文LLM解码中以极低开销达到与全注意力相当的任务质量。
